mostWorthwhile.text: Making the extracellular matrix was most worthwhile: the planned sequence connects gene activity and protein production to secretion and assembly outside the cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: The second differentiation branch repeated the same signal-then-amino-acids pattern, though it provided a useful comparison.

surprise.text: The finished muscle goal stopped at separate, single-nucleus myoblasts rather than a fused mature fibre.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the broadly named differentiation conditions leave the specific signals and how they change gene activity unexplained.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the myoblasts develop into muscle fibres; the distinction between precursors and mature fibres leaves a clear next question.
